newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania sees 1997 result same or better than 1996.
newsitem.headline: Eridania sees 1997 result same or better than 1996.

text.p: Eridania Beghin-Say expects its 1997 result to be in line with, or slightly better, than that of 1996, chairman Stefano Meloni told a news conference on Friday.
"Overall, I remain cautious and say that results for the current year will be in line with, or possibly slightly better, than the results that we have just reported," he said.
Meloni also said that if Eridania managed to improve its net profit, it hoped this would allow the distribution of a dividend representing over 50 percent of net profit.
"If our net result increases, we hope to distribute over 50 percent of our net result," he told reporters.

Eridania said after the stock market close on Thursday that it had increased net attributable profit to 1.660 billion francs in 1996 from 1.526 billion in 1995. It proposed a 1996 dividend of the same level as in 1995, at 33 francs per share.
